content: Sinapun siwa̱youb gamag wasigeis
Awoum kukwa̱nes tamumwey, tage kuyyowal ma̱wana timom wasigeis; o tawbwats ma̱wana budam; nummwey ma̱wana inom; vinabwats ma̱wana nimut, amsinap bikamnat wasigeis.
Kumtakavates siyas nakwabs gewa̱gews, ta-ivag tawlisiyas.
Tage kukin nakwab nitun sam o tibun sam, kadiloka bisiwyoubus nakwab mana̱wen bikatimapus nasiwa̱youb kweiboug wasigeis tasiyas. Sinap towen bwanabwein wamatan Yowbad.
Tage nakwab na̱wen naguwa̱gew, anmwa̱net bises, binnimis Yowbad anmwa̱net bileb, yam babaw o boug babaw bininitoug waseg o biyowal waseg.
Kukin gog nakwab bikalimwa̱saw-wan, o bikamkwam-wan, mamagina takanig, kululuwan mana̱wen.
Kaleiwag towen kuguyes va̱gan kid asisinap bikamnat.

Kadilok gamag tatanok tatanok bimtakavates asigamag. Kukin teitan gamag nag bimtakavates tasiyas wanbunatum nisesus, mtowen mamagina tapiyavein Yowbad nakaleiwag. Tasiyas igaw dadub nag ivag asisinap ma̱wan, peinan singay kalbaleb.

Magat vin bises, namwan anmwa̱net nikanig, o ansinap siwa̱youb, peinan nituyes gamagal, o nimtakavates anbwabwal, o nivna̱ses tasiyas tayekelesiys, o nilabes tasiyas abes igeg wasigeis, o nawotet babaw bwanabwein, igaw anbweilim sinawanim sinawatan, bweina kutam va̱gan tayekelesiys bimtakavates mana̱wen vin.
Tage nakwabs tasiyas igaw vinabwats awoum, peinan igaw ninous bibabaw o binumlaves Kelis, mo bivevaws.
Kweiboug ika̱touts asilivan waseg Kelis, wankuyeim mo biwidis; kalbaleb asisinap ma̱wan.
E, adok mo bikatudabs mav, bunatum babaw bikikeipuls, liva̱nen gamag babaw billivans, mamagina nabugmatuws tasiyas, kakat wudous.
Adok nakwab tasiyas vinabwats kadilok bivevaws, bituyes nitsiyas, bimtakavates siven. Awoum tayekelesiy na̱tan beivay ansinap kalbaleb, mo tasiyas nikamliweids bikines, mo biyyageids; awoum.
Adok nakwab mwasanin bo ikalouws, inoyes Seitan inaked.
Kal vin iyekelesiy, o taliven nakwabs nisesus, kadiloka bimtakavates tasiyas. Awoum wotet avakaein wasigeis tayekelesiys babaw, peinan tayekelesiys bimtakavates nakwabs tasiyas naguwa̱gews.
Kuvna̱ses beibwein tasiyas takalleiwags wasigeis tayekelesiys yakamiy. Tasiyas igguyeimiy Yowbad anilivan waseg, o ikatimlakeimiy sinapun Yowbad, kadiloka kumtakavates beibwein.
Livan nises Bukitab waseg mamagina,

content.text: “Bulumakaw iwwotet wit, bweina beikam wit waseg.”

content: Livan kwayuwein nises,

Awoum gamag makava biyateles wasigeis tayekelesiys situwa̱veks; awoum. Kukin gamag asteiy o asteitoun bikakins sitovek ansinap kalbaleb, asilivan mounid bilivans mo bukuligen va̱gan biyateles tamwey towen.
Kuguyes tasiyas takalbalebs wamtes gamag babaw, gamag babaw mo biwenes sinap kalbaleb.

Adibakeim yak wamatan Yowbad, o wamatan Yeisuw Kelis, o wamtes min-liba̱lab tasiyas Yowbad nagamag, kaleiwag siyas nalel let towen waseg tamtakavatein ya̱koum. Kaleiwag tasiyas kuvkek bimlavag katanok-wan. Awoum teitan gamag kusiwyoub mo son kuyageg; awoum.

Awoum nuwanawa bukusek nawotet tayekelesiy teitan va̱gan bimlavag mamagina misinal; adok bukutagouwaw ansinap kalbaleb nises, gamag mwasanin mo bidokes bukuleb towen ansinap kalbaleb, o bidokeims-vak takalbaleb ya̱koum. Kuvnas amsinap tatoneim beibwein.
Awoum yevagam mav kumwamoum, tage wayn kakit kumwamoum nuwam peinan, o peinan amlel nises wa̱woum.
Gamag mwasanin tawtusis-wan asisinap kalbaleb, mapun nuwanaw bilivatus kalbaleb. Tage mwasanin gamag asisinap kalbaleb ikawumes, tut wanakougwaw mo bilivatus kalbaleb.
Sinap bwanabwein ma̱wan, babaw gamag bikinbunikes; kukin gog bisowmes, igaw wankuyeim mo bikamat.
